# FlyDSL AOT kernel objects — `sdpa`, `gfx11-generic`

72 checked-in code object(s), compiled from the vendored sources under
`flydsl/kernels_src/` in the hip-kernel-provider tree. Regenerate with:

```
python -m generators.gen_sdpa --arch gfx11-generic
```

run from `flydsl/`; see `flydsl/REGEN.md` for the environment.

`gfx11-generic` is an LLVM generic target: these objects run unchanged on `gfx1100`, `gfx1101`, `gfx1102`, `gfx1103`, `gfx1150`, `gfx1151`, `gfx1152`, `gfx1153`. The packer ships them into each of those arches' shards.
